name: nodes
description: The NODE.inf.json node tree: /nodes:chart writes one node per directory that carries information beyond its parent, through the `nodes` tool, so an agent loads a path's context from the root down (`nodes chain <path>`). Refs live in one NODE.refs.json per tree; per repository the whole tree is committed with the code or kept local-only. /nodes:familiarize loads the tree at the start of a session.
